steps.content: The Mania mass ceases to grow and begins to crumble. Though it yearns to survive, a conflicting will within prevents it from withstanding the unified assault from outside.

The massive wisteria tree that once reached for the sky now topples down. It crumbles with firecracker-like pops and crackles, its fragments dissipating akin to withered leaves falling from dead branches.
The living have a future to embrace, while it's time for them to bid farewell to the past.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Darkness scatters and moonlight breaks through the clouds... The tale of the fete... comes to a close at last.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The valiant hero from afar vanquished the life-draining evil spirit and protected his streets. The tormented souls that wandered this world have finally found peace.
steps.female_content: The valiant hero from afar vanquished the life-draining evil spirit and protected her streets. The tormented souls that wandered this world have finally found peace.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: One by one, they break free from the evil wisteria's grasp. As their obsessions fade away with the shadows, they transform into bright, warm figures—ones that stir fond memories.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: After more than a hundred years, they finally remember who they truly were, finding back their uncorrupted souls at long last...

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirits
steps.content:
Yingying said she'd wait for us over there. Let's go, we shouldn't keep the little one waiting too long.
Heh...
Mm, let's go.

steps.speaker: Gold Toad
steps.content: That's right. Let go, just let it go... Only by letting go of your obsession can you truly win at life...

steps.speaker: Lady Rakshasa
steps.content: No more troublemakers around? Then... I'll go ask the wisteria ladies to help me dress up.

steps.speaker: Pixiu Dragon
steps.content: My debt is paid at last! This noble soul is heading home! Home, sweet home—

steps.speaker: Mad Gourd
steps.content: A bright future awaits! A bright future awaits!

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Hehe, mommy—mommy—

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Goodbye, twisted fiends; farewell... endless nightmare. The past can never return, but now, more people will remember them.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: No longer a haunt of evil spirits, no longer a fiends' lair, but once again... a bustling, joyous fete of a new year.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: That's wonderful, truly wonderful...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Now... you, too, can finally find peace...
She returns to her own realm, back to the devastated street, where beneath the wisteria—now nearly burnt to ashes—lies a fallen figure.
That is herself from a hundred years ago.

Her nails shattered, her voice too hoarse for tears. While this hellscape gradually fades away, and even the devastating fires that destroyed them crumble into void, "Yingying" still stays rooted in the ruins, like a withered vine clinging to a solitary grave.
The flower spirit bends down, her tattered vines trailing as she tries to hold that scarred maiden in her arms.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't cry... This isn't the end of the world, and you're not alone...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The hurdles that once seemed impossible... will one day be behind you...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: What we couldn't do... someone else will figure it out...
As she speaks, the sound of footsteps reaches her ears. She looks up, yet her vision is too blurred to see clearly. However...
A gentle smile graces her lips, almost instinctively.
[Chief's default portrait]

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You did wonderfully, sweetheart. I knew you had it in you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come, it's time to write the ending.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Help me end it all...
The new protagonist of the story has arrived. What unfolds before ${PlayerName} is a scene of devastation.

The tree has fallen, its broken branches splayed out like bones protruding from wounds. Countless trapped souls have finally found release, leaving behind only a single, barely recognizable... person.
Somehow, ${PlayerName} knows she must be smiling.
The corruption that lasted a century, the grief and resentment of countless souls—it's finally over. The curse that consumed her entire being has been lifted at last.
FAC Commander-in-Chief

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wake up, Yingying. You're still alive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The illusion of the fete is not gone yet, that jinx star you hate still hangs in the sky, and Yugu can still send me in... This means there's still time to make things right.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Mania might have thrown everything off balance within you, but it has also slowed down time—your body is still rescuable. The medical team is doing their best. We can cleanse the contamination from you and suppress the Mania. I'll give you all the Qi you need—whatever it takes.
A century has passed, but now we can save you. Please, wake up.
The New Year has come. Let's look to the future together, alright?
The figure in your arms remains silent.
The ground begins to shatter and the sky fractures into pieces, yet that unyielding crimson shooting star still hangs high above, overlooking everything.
(Black Screen)
[Transition] The Rust
Wuhuanzi carefully avoids the shackles to check your pulse, her brow furrowing with concern.
After what feels like an eternity, she finally brings herself to let go and shakes her head. The people behind her understand the implications, their expressions growing even more grave.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Purification failed. Operation terminated. Switch to Plan B—separate Chief. He can't be exposed to the contamination any longer.
steps.female_content: ...Purification failed. Operation terminated. Switch to Plan B—separate Chief. She can't be exposed to the contamination any longer.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, wake up! You have to let go. She's gone.

Nightingale attempts to detach you from the lingering contamination, but you remain unresponsive. The shackles binding you to the source of contamination only embed themselves further into the remnants.
Yugu stands and watches from the side as she witnesses both the scene before her and the tale drawing to its inevitable end.

The flower spirit, bound by love for her era, unable to move on or let go, has long lost herself in unattainable wishes. Her fete lies in ruins, yet there is joy in becoming its sacrifice—a century-old wish finally granted.
If it is so, how can you wake her? Why would you wake her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The host must light the lanterns to bid farewell to guests, and the Wisteria Fairy must read everyone's wishes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've decided what wish to make. Won't you come and see it, Wisteria Fairy?
As your consciousness gradually fades away, you struggle to convey your message through the shackles and the withered vines.
Yet, only the taleteller hears these heartfelt words. Behind her veil, she lets out a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You two are so very alike. Both yearning for those beyond your reach, chasing impossible dreams. Love and hatred, life and death, partings and reunions—you bear every weight, whether rightfully yours or not, and willingly sink into the abyss alongside them.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: —What an exquisite tale, precisely the type I've been craving. I am truly thankful for this... entertainment.

In the illusion, the crimson light of the Perishing Star still bathes the two figures, a prison unbreakable over a hundred years. It birthed the beginning of the tale, and will persist until each one meets their inevitable fate.
The taleteller draws her consciousness back to reality. It is time for her departure—she must return to record these captivating scenes while they linger vividly in her memory.
However, after taking one mere step, she halts in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: That's...!
Down on your knees, you cradle the remains of the wisteria. In your dazed state, you notice the light and shadows around you beginning to waver.
Are those wisteria blooms...? With immense effort, you turn your head to look at the sky.

The Perishing Star still hangs high in the fractured sky, but around it, hazy specks of light begin to emerge. They float upward slowly, their faint golden glow gradually spreading and dissolving the crimson light that had engulfed you both.
In your daze, you hear voices from another world echoing through the ruined fete street.
[Small CG]

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Well done, little clapper! You finished exactly when you said you would! Perfect timing for the lantern release!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll go first! Next year, I'm taking everyone back to Goldionville!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hey, don't jump the gun! We agreed to release the lanterns together a few hours after everyone woke up. There's a whole crowd waiting!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I don't want to go that far. Why don't we just hold the fete here again next year? It'll be just as good.
Those are wish lanterns—the living are releasing their wish lanterns into the sky.
Wuhuanzi stands transfixed, watching the lanterns rise above the Rust. Suddenly, the thread hanging by her hand trembles ever so slightly, leaving the herbalist frozen in her spot.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: ...There's still time... No, it has to be now!

The lanterns rise slowly, carrying wishes as they illuminate DisCity's night sky. They pierce through both reality and illusion, transcend a hundred years, and once again light up the streets long drowned in darkness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, Wisteria Fairy... Even without you lighting the lanterns, everyone's carrying on the tradition. And apparently, someone else will be the host next year.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The fete will live on. Don't you need to watch over it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, I'm going to make my wish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My wish is...

options: ...to fulfill the Wisteria Fairy's original wish.

steps.content: Time stretches on and on, until the lantern lights finally outshine the crimson glow. At last, the person in your arms stirs with a response.

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: ...Can I...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Some parts of our past... we don't have to force ourselves to let go. Let's take them with us as we move forward.
With a slight quiver, the ground fractures at your feet, and something sprouts like a seedling, slowly climbing up to your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: ...Then I want to be... like you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bloom, Yingying. The New Year has come.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This time... we'll protect your street together.

Freshly sprouting vines coil around and envelop you, growing rapidly, winding more firmly—like an embrace with all their might. Something drains from within you, making your head spin, but you refuse to close your eyes. You must see this through to the end.
[Scene Change]

And so you watch as every branch sprouts new buds, intertwining and knotting together, growing endlessly upward, rushing like mad towards the falling crimson star. They spread into an enormous net, ready to swallow it whole, and then—

Upon a gust of wind, the wisteria flowers burst into a sprawling canopy, shielding the shattered street underneath. Rising wish lanterns illuminate this floral dome. Whether the lanterns hold up the flowers or the flowers protect the lanterns, you cannot tell. As dawn's light brightens both worlds, waves of cheers reverberate from above the debris.

steps.speaker: Echoes from Bloomfete Street
steps.content: Ward off evil, comes the new! O Wisteria Fairy above, bless us with divine fortune!

steps.speaker: DisCitizens
steps.content: Happy New Year!
The rich fragrance of flowers cascades like a waterfall, and with peace finally in your heart, you allow it to envelop you.
The last thing you see is the now-faded crimson star, drifting gently onto the floral canopy like a seed settling into vast soil, without stirring even the slightest ripple.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: May...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: May all things be renewed, may all wishes come true...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: May all souls find joy... and may the new year surpass the last.
[ED]
That day, the sinister tree vanished, and a new wisteria tree is now sprouting in the distant land.

It is said that those who held dear memories of that fete now search far and wide, meticulously nurturing the wisteria. When the flowers bloom once more, they plan to hold a new fete in DisCity and rejoice with all their hearts.
As for that book, Hazy Fete in a Daze...

It is said that the protagonist boldly seized the author's pen, writing freely and turning the tragic ending into something entirely new, proclaiming, "This is the true story of these lovely people," and even proposed changing the book title.
He shall have his way, then.
steps.female_content: She shall have her way, then.

steps.content: After all, they offered themselves as a shelter and defied fate itself... This is the ending they carved out by themselves.
(MBCC Interrogation Room)
You close the book.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Are you satisfied with how the tale ends?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: *Sighs* ...Here I am, making a rare concession to craft a happy ending only for you, and yet not a single word of gratitude is uttered. How heartbreaking.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Wasn't it a fair trade between us?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You sent me back to the fete multiple times and painfully endured my forced happy ending—all in exchange for a new story.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I've offered myself to your story. As you said, what's about to happen to me would be more to your liking.
Yugu's smile grows more content as her voice takes on a meaningful tone.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Hehe... Indeed.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: After wandering for so many years, I have at last found the most authentic and exquisite tale and... the ideal protagonist for my narrative. Allow me to linger by your side and document the unfolding of your legend.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Fate marches ever forward. Please pen your tale with abandon, bestow upon me more delightful revelations. When the finale draws near, may you bring everything to its grandest crescendo, and then...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: ...embrace your destined end in the most exquisite manner.
You give a casual response, knowing that if you say anything more, she'll mock you for trying so hard only to come up with a placebo ending to appease the wisteria spirit.
Well, what would a taleteller who only watches from the sidelines know?
You leave the reception room and return to your room to check on your new "friend" that FAC retrieved from the ruins—
[Bud CG]

The flowers are yet to bloom, but the fragrance has already enveloped you. This mysterious being from Eastia is truly fascinating—no wonder everyone warned you not to breathe in too much of it lest you get intoxicated.
Unfortunately, it might already be too late.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Have you decided on your wish?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: My sweet—heart?
